contact.success: Thank you. We have received your message and will reply soon.
contact.title: Get in touch

info.announcement_text: Leave empty to use the shipping message from the theme settings.
info.block_image_overrides_icon: Choosing an image replaces the icon.
info.bottom_text: Optional legal line under the copyright. For example, the registered company name and tax id.
info.brand_description: Two or three sentences about who you are. Shown in the footer.
info.brand_intro: These details appear in the footer and on the contact page. Only enter real information: this is what a customer checks before paying.
info.brand_tagline: One short line under the brand name.
info.contact_address: City and country is enough. A store with no visible location reads as untrustworthy.
info.contact_form_success: Shown after the form is sent successfully.
info.contact_phone: Shown as typed, and turned into a call link.
info.cta_default_url: Leave empty and the button jumps to the offer section on this page.
info.dark_panel: Background of the announcement bar, the final call to action and the footer.
info.enable_product_json_ld: Turn this off if an SEO app already outputs product structured data. Two Product blocks on one page cause Search Console warnings.
info.final_cta_image: Optional. With an image the section is laid out in two columns; without one, centred.
info.footer_brand: The name, tagline, description and contact details are edited in Theme settings › Brand and contact.
info.footer_columns: Each column is a block with its own menu. Create them under Navigation.
info.gallery_layout: "Thumbnails" shows the large image with the others beside it. "Carousel" slides them horizontally.
info.guarantee_policy: Describe the guarantee you actually offer. Do not promise terms you cannot honor.
info.hero_heading: Leave empty to use the product name. This text is the page main heading, the only level-one heading on it.
info.home_featured: Pick a collection. If left empty, the section is not shown.
info.include_quantity: Optional. Shown before the text: "2 × Replacement filter".
info.includes_image: Optional. Ideally a photograph of everything that arrives, out of the box.
info.is_demo: Reviews marked as demo display a visible notice and are excluded from structured data.
info.media_poster: For Shopify-hosted video, this image is used as the poster.
info.muted: Used for supporting text. Check that it keeps AA contrast against the background.
info.offer_mode: "Variants" reads prices from Shopify and never drifts. "Quantity" requires you to create the automatic discount in the admin and declare it here.
info.overlay_opacity: Raise it if the text is hard to read over the image.
info.payment_bnpl: Only enable this if installments are active in your gateway.
info.payment_cash: Cash payment at agent banks, not cash on delivery.
info.payments_intro: Only check the methods you actually have enabled in your gateway. Showing a method you do not offer is misleading advertising.
info.problem_image: Optional. With an image the section is laid out in two columns, the photograph of the real situation beside the points.
info.quantity_discount: This must match the automatic discount you created in the admin. If it does not, the customer sees a different price than at checkout.
info.reviews_aggregate: The average rating and review count are read from the standard reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count metafields. If the product has neither, no stars are shown.
info.reviews_metaobject: Requires the landing_review metaobject to exist in the shop. See docs/metaobjects.md.
info.sale: Used for sale prices and discount badges.
info.section_background: Alternates the background to separate sections visually. Use sparingly: two or three bands across the whole page.
info.section_spacing: Default vertical spacing between landing sections.
info.shipping_claim: Appears in the header and the trust bar.
info.shipping_policy: Short text shown next to the buy button.
info.show_policies: Lists the policies published under Settings › Policies. A policy that does not exist cannot be shown.
info.show_variant_picker: Turn this off if the offer section handles bundle selection.
info.social_intro: Leave a network empty and its icon is not rendered.
info.sticky_header: The header stays visible while scrolling. Useful when the cart matters.
info.tier_title: Leave empty to show the number of units.
info.type_scale: Multiplies the size of each heading level.
info.ugc_rights: Only upload photos you have permission to publish. A customer posting about your product does not license you to use their photo.
info.whatsapp_message: The text the conversation opens with.
